title: trochera bulbosa
intro: Trochera bulbosa, commonly known as the Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Trochera bulbosa include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
